_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_AutoDisableDesc: Foot IK is switched off while any of these are active:
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_ClampAnkleTip: Hard cap on how far IK may lift or drop a foot from its rest height. Applied on the next refresh.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_CreatureIKTip: Builds foot IK data for creatures that ship without any. Expect rough edges; details land in FeetOfSkyrim.log.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_CushionTimeTip: How many updates the correction pause lasts after a foot crosses a step edge. Longer is smoother on stairs but delays planting slightly.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_CushionTip: When the ground under a foot suddenly changes height, like at a stair edge, briefly let the animation drive the legs instead of correcting them. Stops feet jolting on stairs; planting resumes as soon as the foot settles.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_DebugLogTip: Logs every toe write to FeetOfSkyrim.log.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_EnabledTip: Master toggle. Turning this off clears all toe data and puts foot planting back to vanilla.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_GainsDesc: Engine foot IK settings (fIK*). Only used by the Vanilla engine solver, and nothing is touched unless the override box is ticked.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_KeepMovingTip: The game normally switches foot IK off while walking or running. This keeps it on.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_KeepStairsTip: The game normally switches foot IK off on stairs. This keeps it on.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_LogFeetTip: Writes the raw foot IK data for the player and nearby NPCs to FeetOfSkyrim.log. Best used standing on a slope in third person.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_MaxDistTip: Skip foot IK for characters farther than this from the player. 0 means no limit.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_MeshToes: Read toe positions from the model
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_MeshToesTip: Finds the tip of the foot (or boot) straight from the character model, so creatures and modded meshes work without config files. Config files become a manual override.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_OStimTip: Switches foot IK off for everyone in an OStim scene and back on when it ends.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_OverrideGainsTip: Writes the values below into the game settings.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_PlantToesTip: Gives every foot a toe point so the engine plants toes as well as heels. This is the main feature - leave it on.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_RefreshTip: Recomputes toe data for everyone loaded and restarts their foot IK. Use after changing config files.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SlopeGainsTip: Raises the engine's foot IK response while standing on steep ground. Experimental.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SolverBodyTip: How long the body takes to sink or recover when a foot reaches for lower ground.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SolverLowerTip: How long a foot takes to ease down onto lower ground. 0 reacts instantly; higher looks softer but follows later.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SolverRaiseTip: How long a foot takes to ease up onto higher ground. Keep this short so feet don't sink into steps.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SolverSteadyTip: How many frames a new step height must persist before the feet react. Higher is steadier on stair edges but reacts later.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_SolverTip: Feet of Skyrim is this mod's own leg solver: whole-foot planting, smooth stairs, and body lowering. Vanilla engine keeps the game's built-in foot IK with this mod's toe planting added on top.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_ToeReachTip: Scales the detected toe length. Lower it a little if feet snag on stair edges. Takes effect when you release the slider.
line:menu_translation/feetofskyrim:inter.$FOS_VanillaDesc: These settings only apply when the solver is set to Vanilla engine.
